name: Gästehaus Fuchs
beschreibung:
Sunnily situated in family-friendly Sillian, Gaestehaus Fuchs offers comfortable guestrooms with breathtaking views of the surrounding Dolomites. It provides an ideal home base for exploring East Tyrol.

The Hochpustertal ski center, the Drau cycle path, and alpine trails are only minutes away.
kurzbeschreibung: Gaestehaus Fuchs in Sillian provides comfortable accommodation in sunny East Tyrol's Hochpustertal.
